snippet.title: World Cup Golf: Professional Edition (PS1) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A playthrough of U.S. Gold's 1996 Sony PlayStation golf game, World Cup Golf: Professional Edition.

A single round played on the feature game mode. It repeats through four rounds to get to the end of the game mode, and well, I didn't feel like repeating the same thing over and over. So, a single round it is. 

This is a major step up from the original CD-i game, if for no other reason that the controller feels better for it. Dear God, this interface. I think they purposely made it as difficult as possible to figure out what button does what. 

No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
